{{Top|leg}}
The '''Era of Rebellion''' was the [[Time/Legends|time]] period during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. The term was designated by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Historian/Legends|historians]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].
